comments.author: MySQL Verification Team
comments.text: Also, SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS query modifier and accompanying FOUND_ROWS() function are deprecated as of MySQL 8.0.17 and will be removed in a future release. Consider using COUNT(*) instead. Please see https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/information-functions.html#function_found-rows

comments.author: Bill Karwin
comments.text:
Thanks, I know that FOUND_ROWS() is deprecated. Deprecated does not mean buggy or that it fails in arbitrary ways. Deprecated means it should continue to work as it had worked in the past, to give users a chance to adopt another solution.

Also, the same bug occurs in connectors that call the C API function mysql_affected_rows(). The C API is not deprecated.
